meta.title: Frankencoin security: audits, bug bounty and independent ratings
meta.description: Seven audits by four firms, a bug bounty run by Compass Security, and independent risk ratings from Xerberus and Pharos.

hero.title: Audited, rated, and open to anyone who finds a bug.
hero.subtitle: Every Frankencoin component is audited before launch. A bug bounty pays for responsible disclosure, and independent protocols rate the system from public data.

summary.title: Bug bounty
summary.description: Run by Compass Security for bugs that affect the system's stability.

summary.title: Independent ratings
summary.description: Xerberus and Pharos score the protocol from on-chain data.

summary.title: Open source
summary.description: All contracts are public and verified on every chain.
